ValidationRule.description: A Fee Waiver related Processing Status must be selected if Fee Waiver is set as the Sub-Category, the Case is part of the NAS process and is Closed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.Name="ASU Admission Services", (CC_Sub_Category__r.Name= "Fee Waiver Inquiry"), NOT ISPICKVAL(Processing_Status__c, "Approved"), NOT ISPICKVAL(Processing_Status__c, "Approved - by Recruiter"), NOT ISPICKVAL (Processing_Status__c, "Received - App Fee Paid"), NOT ISPICKVAL (Processing_Status__c, "Received - Missing Info"), NOT ISPICKVAL (Processing_Status__c, "Received - Needs to Apply/Re-Apply"), NOT ISPICKVAL (Processing_Status__c, "Received - Not Applicable"), Needs_Attention__c, OR ( ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL (Status, "Closed: Customer Unresponsive") ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Fee Waiver related Processing Status must be selected if Fee Waiver is set as the Sub-Category, the Case is part of the NAS process and is Closed.
